demo2_independent_qca_only.outcome: DEC_AUTH (Substantive Expert Decision Authority over Case Judgments)
diagnosed_blind_spots_of_qca_only: Blind Spot 1 (Conflated High-Authority Regimes): Truth-table Row 0100 (~COERC*INST_SHD*~BND_INF*~EPI_VAL: LEB-BREAST, LEB-BONE, WAA) passes DEC_AUTH sufficiency (incl=0.910, PRI=0.862), lumping unengaged radiologists who ignored AI and police brokers who monopolized a black box together with engaged co-designers.

Blind Spot 2 (Unresolved Coercive-Entry Contradiction): Eight cases enter with high coercive substitution (ALG_SUB>=4, MGT_CTRL>=4, PROF_JUR<=2), yet split across GIA-DSL (retained/co-evolved), EIN-T & GIA-RM (supervisory override), MAY-BIO & MAY-REC (client-facing reconstruction), and STR-BANK, MON, VDB-LM (displaced). Static QCA cannot see the temporal breakdown and client-mobilization mechanisms that separate them.

Blind Spot 3 (10 Synthesis-Only Studies Excluded): Field-level and pre-deployment papers (e.g., Kellogg et al. 2025 on failed junior-to-senior coaching; Vuori et al. 2025 on covert data manipulation; Goto 2021-2023 on anticipatory profession-level work) cannot enter a case-by-condition truth table without fabricating case boundaries.

method_fit_diagnostic.recommended_pathway: Hybrid Multi-Method Triangulation (Multi-Outcome fsQCA + 4-Stage Process-Sequence + 2D Regime Clustering)

candidates.pathway: Hybrid Multi-Method Triangulation (Multi-Outcome fsQCA + 4-Stage Process-Sequence + 2D Regime Clustering)
candidates.rationale: Best fit: 27 cases support cross-case Boolean minimization, while 16/27 (59.3%) longitudinal cases and n_outcomes=2 (bifurcation=True) require combining multi-outcome fsQCA, Markov sequence analysis, and 2D regime discriminant analysis.

candidates.pathway: 2D Four-Regime Clustering & Non-Parametric Kruskal-Wallis Discriminant Analysis
candidates.rationale: Disaggregates 2 outcome dimensions across 27 cases and ranks construct effect sizes (Kruskal-Wallis eta^2) without forcing single-dimension collapse.

candidates.pathway: Longitudinal Process-Sequence & Information-Theoretic Trajectory Analysis Alone
candidates.rationale: Strong process signal (16/27 longitudinal cases, 59.3%): resolves temporal ordering and breakdown-triggered transitions, and complements cross-case set analysis.

Captures cross-case Boolean equifinality across 27 cases, but static single-outcome QCA alone is penalized by outcome skew (77.8% positive=True), longitudinal process share (59.3%), n_outcomes=2, and within-corner bifurcation=True.

candidates.pathway: Qualitative Relational Synthesis & Specification-Gap Report Only
candidates.rationale: Corpus has sufficient bounded cases (N=27) to support formal cross-case analytical engines.

Assumes symmetric additive marginal effects and independent observations; mis-specified for conjunctural, equifinal, or small-to-medium qualitative case corpora (retained only as a diagnostic contrast).
Qualitative studies describe actor interactions narratively without calibrated micro-transition parameters; running an ABM would require invented parameters.
